title: Visit LIGO’s Livingston observatory
description: At LIGO Livingston, the science education center makes gravitational waves less abstract through hands-on exhibits and public tours. Learn why two long detector arms can register the tiny ripples from distant black-hole mergers, then see the working observatory’s Louisiana setting. Science Saturdays offer a way to visit a place where people are listening to the universe.
teaser: Explore the observatory that detects gravitational waves.
goodToKnow: Science Saturday dates and available tour areas can change; check the LIGO calendar and access details.
whyItMightDelightYou: Standing near a real instrument built for something so faint can change the scale of your imagination.
